title: School Breakfast in a Departed-Balance Cover — School Nutrition Services Meal Account Points of Judgement
content:
A departed-balance cover to a School Nutrition Services Meal Account adds a reimbursable breakfast to each serving day when a reimbursable breakfast was rung up on the account in the month before the cover date: the secondary breakfast charge of the student's meal status when the account's campus is Ridgecrest Middle School, Calloway Creek High School or Mesquite Ridge High School; the elementary breakfast charge of the status when it is any other campus not listed as a CEP campus; nothing when no breakfast was rung up in that month or the account's campus is a CEP campus (Cypress Hollow Elementary, Pecan Grove Elementary, Hollis Middle School), where breakfast is served at no charge.

A date falls within the N months before the cover date when fewer than N whole calendar months separate it from the cover date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month or, when that later month has no such day, on the first day of the month after it.

## Points of judgement

| Breakfast rung up on the account in the month before the cover date | Account's campus | Added to each serving day |
|---|---|---|
| yes | Ridgecrest Middle School, Calloway Creek High School, Mesquite Ridge High School | the secondary breakfast charge of the meal status |
| yes | any other campus that is not a CEP campus | the elementary breakfast charge of the meal status |
| yes | a CEP campus | nothing |
| no | any campus | nothing |

- The campus read here is the meal account's own campus.
- One breakfast in the month is enough; the count of breakfasts does not change the amount.

Hypothetical: a cover date of March 10, 2027. A breakfast rung up on February 11, 2027 falls within the month before it (less than one whole month separates the two dates); one rung up on February 10, 2027 does not, a whole month being reached on March 10. A Paid Meal Status account at Alder Springs Elementary with a breakfast on February 22 adds 1.85 to each serving day; the same account with its last breakfast on February 5 adds nothing.
